data.name: SpinObi : Just One More Wave
data.detailed_description:
Master the shadows, redefine survival.

In a genre defined by passive combat, SpinObi : Just One More Wave puts the power back in your hands. Take control of a legendary Ninja and face an relentless onslaught of mystical horrors. This isn’t just about choosing the right upgrades—it’s about precision, timing, and mastering the art of high-speed movement.

Dash through skeletons, hook yourself across the battlefield to escape stone golems, and weave through a bullet-hell of poisonous spores. Survival is a choice. Your skills are the weapon.

High-Octane Mechanical Combat

Forget just walking around. Use your Dash to phase through enemy attacks and your Grappling Hook to navigate the chaos. Whether you’re pulling yourself out of a corner or diving headfirst into the fray, the battlefield is your playground.

An Evolving Arsenal

Experience classic Roguelike progression with a ninja twist. Collect powerful scrolls, enhance your elemental abilities, and create game-breaking builds that turn your simple dash into a trail of fire or your hook into a deadly chain of lightning.

The Horde Awaits

Face a diverse bestiary of mythical threats:

  • Flying Trees: Watch the skies as nature itself turns against you.

  • Stone Golems: Massive, unstoppable titans that require perfect positioning to take down.

  • Exploding Mushrooms & Poisonous Spiders: One wrong move can be your last. Stay mobile, stay alive.

Die, Learn, Transcend

Every run earns you permanent upgrades. Unlock new ninja techniques, increase your reflexes, and return to the battlefield stronger than ever. Can you survive long enough to uncover the source of the corruption?
